items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Raised surface with a fine border, layered depth, and inset edge light.

api.summary: Card-stock (or dark) container with the shared surface border, card shadow, 28px radius, and 40px padding.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles merged last; use for width, height, or layout, not for new shadows.

props.name: dark
props.description: Uses the dark code-card fill with the dark border and shadow tokens.

stage.reason: Width fills its container and height follows the children. The card adds 40px padding and a 1px border on each side (82 stage pixels over the content); set style.width or style.height for a fixed box.

examples.title: Dark card with a headline
examples.code:
import { Card } from "@/jbm/ui/card"
import { color } from "@/jbm/lib/tokens"
import { Big } from "@/jbm/ui/big" // install @jbm/big separately

<Card dark><Big color={color.bg}>Surface</Big></Card>

qa: Compare the light and dark surfaces on cream: fine border, layered shadow, and the inset highlight on the upper edge.
Check that content-driven height plus the 82px of padding and border still fits the safe area.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: Number that counts up to a target.

api.summary: Renders a Big numeral that eases from 0 to `n`, rounded to whole numbers, on the Remotion timeline.

props.name: n
props.description: Target value; the count ends here and holds.

props.name: at
props.description: Start time in seconds from the start of the sequence.

props.name: dur
props.description: Seconds the count takes to reach `n`.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size in stage pixels, passed to Big.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color; keep the one vermilion accent per composition.

stage.basis: One line of Big at size 140 with line-height 1.05. Height is size × 1.05; width follows the digit count of `n` (about 0.6 × size per digit).

examples.title: Count to a key number
examples.code:
import { Counter } from "@/jbm/motion/counter"

<Counter n={1024} at={0.2} dur={1.5} />

examples.title: Smaller, in ink, beside other text
examples.code:
import { Counter } from "@/jbm/motion/counter"
import { color } from "@/jbm/lib/tokens"

<Counter n={42} at={1} size={96} color={color.ink} />
// Render inside a Remotion <Composition> or <Player>.

qa: Step to the first, middle, and last frames: 0 before `at`, an intermediate whole number mid-count, and exactly `n` at rest.
Check the widest value of `n` stays inside the safe area at the chosen size in both orientations.
Confirm only one element on the stage uses the accent color.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: Controlled folder illustration that pulls its sheet upright from 0 to 1.

api.summary: Accent or ink folder whose sheet rotates upright and clears the front panel as `open` goes from 0 to 1. Pure React with no internal timer; drive `open` from a slider or a video timeline.

props.name: children
props.description: SVG contents in the 260×220 folder space, drawn behind its front panel.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono label printed on the front panel; also names the image for assistive technology. Truncated after 16 characters.

props.name: open
props.description: Opening progress from 0 (closed) to 1 (sheet upright). Clamped; non-finite values render closed.

props.name: tone
props.description: Folder fill: vermilion accent or ink.

api.summary: The complete back silhouette with its tab, as an SVG path. Shared by Folder, FolderContents, FolderCarry, and filing drawers so hidden geometry stays consistent.

props.name: x
props.description: Left edge in the parent SVG's units.

props.name: y
props.description: Top of the tab.

props.name: w
props.description: Body width.

props.name: h
props.description: Height from the top of the tab to the bottom edge.

props.name: tabX
props.description: Left edge of the tab; defaults to the body's left edge.

props.name: tabWidth
props.description: Tab width, including its slope.

props.name: tabHeight
props.description: Tab height above the body.

props.name: tabSlope
props.description: Horizontal run of the tab's slanted edge.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill color; the 2px ink edge is fixed.

stage.basis: Fixed 260×220 viewBox rendered at 260×220 stage pixels. It keeps its aspect ratio: set style.width to scale (height is auto), and it shrinks to maxWidth 100% of its container.

examples.title: Half-open folder
Drive it from a Remotion timeline
examples.code:
import { Folder } from "@/jbm/ui/folder"
import { useProgress } from "@/jbm/motion/hooks" // install @jbm/motion-hooks separately

const open = useProgress(0.5, 1, 0.8)
<Folder label="proyecto" tone="ink" open={open} style={{ width: 390 }} />

qa: Drag open through 0, 0.5, and 1: the sheet never cuts through the front panel and its lower corner clears the folder edge.
Check the label stays on the front plane while it foreshortens, and long labels truncate with an ellipsis.
Compare accent and ink tones; the ink folder keeps a visible 2px edge on cream.
Scale with style.width at narrow widths: the silhouette keeps its 260:220 proportions.
